caption: The drawing features six rectangular swatches of patterned fabric arranged in a loosely symmetrical composition on a plain, off-white background. In the top left, there is a dark brown swatch with a repeating pattern of light pink flowers and dotted vine-like lines. To its right, near the top center, there is a beige swatch featuring small, red flowers with green stems, several placed near the edges and scattered across the surface. Slightly below and further to the left, a larger, pale peach swatch is decorated with two groups of red flowers with green stems, each positioned near the left and top-right corners. In the lower left corner is a small, light beige swatch with a single small green leaf and yellow flower connected by a black line extending horizontally. Centrally located on the right is a medium-sized, dark brown swatch with a repeating diamond grid formed by small yellow dots. In the lower right corner, a large beige swatch is patterned with brown leaves, thin black stems, and red-orange berry-like dots connected by curving lines, creating an organic, flowing design. Each swatch is distinct in color and motif, contributing to the overall patchwork appearance. The lower right hand side bears a faint typewritten marking, "TEXTILE LICHTEN."
title: Materials from Patchwork Bedspread
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
